message.content:
A magazine cover features a black background with a red vertical stripe on the left edge. At the top, "TEMPO" is printed in large, teal, capital letters. Above it, white text reads "PARA PENERIMA UPETI PENGUASA PELABUHAN / GANJALAN BARU DIVESTASI FREEPORT". Below the title is the slogan "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU".

The central illustration depicts a glowing, white-and-teal horizontal waveform line that oscillates vertically across the frame. Two sections of this line form the silhouettes of human profiles facing each other. One profile on the left is a woman's face, while the right profile is a man's face. Both profiles are outlined by the peaks and valleys of the wave.

Below the waveform, large white text reads "HALO-HALO YANG BIKIN GELO". Underneath, smaller white text explains that the "DPR BERENCANA MEMBUAT PANITIA KHUSUS UNTUK MENELISIK REKAMAN PERCAKAPAN RINI SOEMARNO DENGAN DIREKTUR UTAMA PLN." At the bottom right, a barcode, price "RP 45.000", date "7-13 MEI 2018", and "ISSN: 0126-4273" are visible.
